doc.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]

title: Was the Condon crowd as wild as the books say?
summary: Budd recalls Condon's drinking and talk of reefers, but no narcotics; later modern musicians did seek his help.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Was the Condon bunch as wild as the books say?

Well yes, depends on what you mean by wild. He drank a lot you know, and I never said, he probably smoked marijuana, I don’t know. I heard him talk about “reefers” and “muggles” and things like that. I never had seen one. But as far as drugs, like narcotics, they never mentioned that to me or anything about it at all. I have had that experience later with more modern musicians that have talked about it, and solicited help that I couldn’t give.
